description: This file defines a custom error decoder for Feign clients in a Java project, handling JSON error responses from a Fineract API. It interprets error responses, extracts meaningful error messages, including validation errors, and throws appropriate exceptions.

classes.name: FineractErrorDecoder
classes.description: Custom Feign error decoder that processes JSON error responses to create detailed exceptions.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the HTTP response to an Exception, interpreting JSON error messages and extracting validation errors.

methods.name: readResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body as a byte array.

methods.name: extractField
methods.description: Extracts a specific string field from a JsonNode.

methods.name: extractValidationErrors
methods.description: Gathers validation errors from the 'errors' array in the JSON response, concatenating the messages.
